newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - National Assembly starts five-day collective review of proposed constitutional amendments
Third left-right coalition government to be formed in France
UNITED DAILY NEWS - French Socialist Lionel Jospin to form cabinet
Family of ten killed in car crash in southern Taiwan
LIBERTY TIMES - Nationalist, Democratic Progressive parties to hold second round of talks on constitutional amendments
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance ministry to annouce auction of four state land parcels in Taipei's expensive Hsinyi district
State-owned Chinese Petroleum may adopt floating oil price system and reduce oil prices in July
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Finance ministry to revise banking law to make local banks require higher credit ratings of firms to which they intend to grant loans
Chinese Petroleum expected to adopt floating oil price system in July
